criterion_fired: Criterion 2 (carry-forward regression), Criterion 3 (champion evidence), Criterion 4 (next steps specificity)
suggested_change: Criterion 2 should require: 'Score regression only if call transcript contains new negative information contradicting prior assessment; silence/absence of new positive data alone does not justify downgrade. Notation: "No new information—maintaining [prior score]."' Criterion 3 should require: 'Champion score reflects only on-call or documented evidence of internal advocacy; absence of new advocacy mentions does not reduce score unless prior calls showed active advocacy that has now stopped.' Criterion 4 should require: 'Next steps must include: [Contact name]: [Specific question] by [date]; avoid vague directives like "ask directly" without question structure.'
